surface.description: Sheets and raised surfaces; never for the screen background

ink.description: Primary text and icons on ground or surface

ink-muted.description: Secondary text and captions; 4.5:1 or better on ground

accent.description: The one primary action per screen and its focus ring. Not for decoration

on-accent.description: Text and icons placed on accent

1.description: Base unit; every gap is a multiple of it

2.description: Inside a group: icon to label, row padding

4.description: Screen side margin and gap between groups

display.description: One per screen: the thing the screen is about

caption.description: Metadata under a title; never for actions
